helpText.zh-CN: 按公告标题关键词查找；清除关键词可查看全部公告。
helpText.en-US: Search by announcement title keywords. Clear the keywords to show all announcements.

description.zh-CN: 选择“新建公告”创建草稿，或清除筛选条件查看已有公告。
description.en-US: Choose Create Announcement to draft a notice, or clear the filters to view existing announcements.

helpText.zh-CN: 仅可选择当前发布管理范围内的有效成员。
helpText.en-US: Choose active members within your current publication scope.

helpText.zh-CN: 包含下级；仅列出整个子树均已授权的部门。
helpText.en-US: Includes descendants. Only fully authorized department subtrees are selectable.

helpText.zh-CN: 仅通知当前管理范围内的该角色成员，发布时重新解析。
helpText.en-US: Only role members within your current management scope; resolved again at publication.

helpText.zh-CN: 可先保存草稿。提交前选择可用流程，或使用租户公告政策中的默认流程。
helpText.en-US: You can save the draft first. Before submission, select an available workflow or use the tenant default.

helpText.zh-CN: 留空为立即发布；审批未在预约时间前就绪时不会补发。
helpText.en-US: Leave empty for immediate publication. Late approval does not trigger a missed schedule.

placeholder.zh-CN: 例如：已批准的例行维护通知

helpText.zh-CN: 免审提交必须有独立免审权限并说明原因。
helpText.en-US: Exempt submission requires separate exemption permission and a reason.

helpText.zh-CN: 重要公告默认开启；阅读与确认是两个独立动作。
helpText.en-US: Enabled by default for important notices. Reading and acknowledgement are separate.

helpText.zh-CN: 发布后 1–30 天，默认 7 天；到期后仍可确认。
helpText.en-US: 1–30 days from publication, default 7. Late acknowledgement remains available.

helpText.zh-CN: 请求受理后将核对实际流程结果；尚未发布的公告会停止自动发布。
helpText.en-US: The request reconciles the authoritative workflow outcome and prevents an unpublished version from being automatically released.

placeholder.zh-CN: 例如：发布安排调整，撤销本次申请
placeholder.en-US: e.g. Publication plans changed; withdraw this request

placeholder.zh-CN: 例如：10 月 12 日系统维护通知

helpText.zh-CN: 可先保存未完成的草稿，再从公告列表的“通知设置”选择受众、发布方式和知悉要求。
helpText.en-US: Save an incomplete draft, then use Notification settings from the announcement list to choose the audience, approval mode and acknowledgement policy.

placeholder.zh-CN: 说明适用对象、具体事项和生效时间
placeholder.en-US: Describe the audience, details and effective time

helpText.zh-CN: 补充影响范围、时间安排和需要读者采取的行动。
helpText.en-US: Explain the impact, schedule and any action readers should take.

helpText.zh-CN: 最多 10 个附件；单文件限制以服务器当前上传配置为准。
helpText.en-US: Up to 10 attachments. The current server upload configuration determines the file-size limit.

emptyText.zh-CN: 此版本尚无发布执行记录。
emptyText.en-US: This version has no publication execution record.

content.zh-CN: 沿用原版本、操作者和时间窗口，重新检查发布条件；不会替换正文、重新批准或延长窗口。
content.en-US: Keep the original version, actor and time window, and recheck publication conditions. This does not replace content, approve again, or extend the window.

description.zh-CN: 请刷新；发布人仅显示有权查看的账户名称。
description.en-US: Refresh to view authorized publisher names.

description.zh-CN: 请刷新或调整筛选；这里只显示你有权查看的有效公告。
description.en-US: Refresh or adjust filters. Only active announcements available to your current membership appear here.

content.zh-CN: 知悉截止时间已过。公告仍有效时，你可以继续确认知悉，系统将记录逾期完成。
content.en-US: The acknowledgement deadline has passed. You can still acknowledge while this announcement is active; completion will be recorded as late.

content.zh-CN: 你已确认知悉，首次确认时间会保留。
content.en-US: Your first acknowledgement has been recorded.

content.zh-CN: 公告政策仅作用于当前租户。安全规则在执行时实时复查；提醒时刻、次数和免打扰窗口仅供新提交版本冻结使用，不追溯修改已有公告。
content.en-US: Policy applies to the current tenant. Security rules are rechecked at execution. Reminder timing, limits and quiet hours are frozen for new submissions and do not reschedule existing announcements.

helpText.zh-CN: 收紧后立即复查尚未执行的发布任务。
helpText.en-US: A tighter rule is rechecked before pending publication executes.

helpText.zh-CN: 仅可新选当前可用且本人有权使用的流程；已有实例保持原流程。
helpText.en-US: New selections require a qualified available workflow. Existing instances keep their original definition.

label.zh-CN: 发布技术延迟窗口（分钟）

helpText.zh-CN: 1–120 分钟，仅用于已获许可的发布技术重试，不为逾期审批补发。
helpText.en-US: 1–120 minutes for authorized technical retries. Late approval never triggers a missed publication.

helpText.zh-CN: HH:mm，使用公告版本冻结的租户时区。
helpText.en-US: HH:mm in the tenant time zone frozen for the announcement version.

helpText.zh-CN: 1–3 次。没有合格收件人的扫描不消耗次数。
helpText.en-US: 1–3 batches. Scans without eligible recipients do not consume the limit.

helpText.zh-CN: 60–1440 分钟；手动和自动催办共用。
helpText.en-US: 60–1440 minutes, shared by manual and automatic reminders.

helpText.zh-CN: 开始与结束同时填写或同时留空；支持跨午夜，结束时刻可发送。
helpText.en-US: Set or clear both times together. Overnight intervals are supported; reminders are allowed at the end time.

message.zh-CN: 公告政策已保存；已有公告的提醒时间保持不变。
message.en-US: Announcement policy saved. Existing announcements keep their frozen reminder schedule.

content.zh-CN: 默认审批流程可在“编辑政策”中查看、更换或移除。知悉截止后停止自动催办，但有效公告仍允许手动催办和确认。免打扰时段同时留空表示未配置；新公告默认每日 09:00、最多三次。
content.en-US: View, replace or remove the default workflow in Edit policy. Automatic reminders stop at the acknowledgement deadline; active announcements still allow manual reminders and acknowledgement. Empty quiet-hour fields mean no quiet interval is configured. New announcements default to 09:00 daily and at most three automatic batches.

content.zh-CN: 固定版本、固定统计时间。筛选不改变历史分母，重新统计会生成新快照。已读与已知悉分别统计；失效成员保留在历史名单，未知或不适用项单独标明。网络中断时请保持本页快照，刷新后重试导出会沿用原请求。
content.en-US: One fixed version and capture time. Filters preserve the historical denominator; recapturing creates a new snapshot. Reading and acknowledgement are separate. Inactive members remain in history; unknown and inapplicable values are identified. After a connection loss, keep this capture and reload to retry the original export request.

helpText.zh-CN: 搜索发布时封存的姓名，最多 200 字。
helpText.en-US: Search frozen publication names, up to 200 characters.

helpText.zh-CN: 仅列出本快照中当前有权查看的部门；留空为全部。
helpText.en-US: Only currently authorized departments in this capture are listed. Leave empty for all.

helpText.zh-CN: 切换版本会清除筛选，并生成该版本的新统计。
helpText.en-US: Switching versions clears filters and creates a new capture for that version.

legacy_migration.zh-CN: 存量迁移（历史阅读未知）

__default.zh-CN: 迁移名单（历史数据未知）

title.zh-CN: 当前权限已变更，请返回公告重新统计。
title.en-US: Permissions changed. Return to the announcement and capture again.

title.zh-CN: 翻页失败，仍展示上一次的数据。重试后再操作。
title.en-US: Paging failed. Previous data is shown; retry before acting.

description.zh-CN: 没有符合当前筛选的接收人。请调整筛选；历史分母保持不变。
description.en-US: No recipients match these filters. Adjust filters; the historical denominator is unchanged.

content.zh-CN: 导出文件固定保留受理时的版本、统计时间与筛选结果，24 小时内可下载。刷新仅查询原任务；权限变化后可能无法下载，请重新统计。失败、取消或过期后，可查看此版本最新统计并创建新导出。
content.en-US: The file preserves the accepted version, capture time and filters, and is available for 24 hours. Refresh checks this task. Changed permissions can prevent download; capture again. For failed, canceled or expired tasks, view the latest statistics for this version and create another export.

label.en-US: View latest statistics for this version

$i18n:export.domain_failed.zh-CN: 生成失败。请返回统计页重新创建导出。
$i18n:export.domain_failed.en-US: Generation failed. Return to statistics and create a new export.

description.zh-CN: 请刷新进度；生成完成后可查看文件信息。
description.en-US: Refresh progress to see file information after generation.

title.zh-CN: 结果刷新失败，仍展示上一次的文件信息，请重试。
title.en-US: Result refresh failed. Previous artifact information is shown; retry.

content.zh-CN: 预览有效 30 分钟，提交时重新计算实际人数。未读和待知悉合并为一条提醒；手动与自动共用一小时去重。公告有效时截止后仍可手动催办。网络中断后保留本预览并刷新重试原请求。
content.en-US: The preview is valid for 30 minutes; submission recalculates eligibility. Unread and unacknowledged work share one reminder and the manual/automatic deduplication window. Manual reminders remain available after the deadline while the announcement is active. After a connection loss, keep this preview and reload to retry the original request.

content.zh-CN: 提交时会重新检查未完成状态和一小时去重。站内提醒生成不代表用户已读或已知悉。
content.en-US: Submission rechecks unfinished work and the shared deduplication window. A generated notification does not mean that the recipient has read or acknowledged it.

throttled.zh-CN: 去重窗口内，暂无新增提醒

description.zh-CN: 请刷新同一预览或批次；不会重新发送。
description.en-US: Refresh the same preview or batch. This does not resend notifications.

title.zh-CN: 刷新失败，仍显示上次事实，请重试。
title.en-US: Refresh failed. Previous facts remain visible; retry.

content.zh-CN: 本页刷新只查询原批次，不会重新发送。“提醒已生成”仅表示站内通知已持久化，不表示已读或已知悉。受理后完成、成员失效或操作者失权会跳过。实际人数可能与预览不同；限流与零人数批次不增加自动额度。
content.en-US: Refresh only queries this batch. Completed means the in-app notification was persisted, not read or acknowledged. Completion, inactive membership or revoked authority can skip accepted work. Actual counts may differ from the preview; empty or throttled batches do not consume automatic quota.

blocked.zh-CN: 权限或版本变化，已阻断
blocked.en-US: Blocked by authority or version change

description.zh-CN: 请刷新同一预览或批次；不会重新发送。
description.en-US: Refresh the same preview or batch. This does not resend notifications.

title.zh-CN: 刷新失败，仍显示上次事实，请重试。
title.en-US: Refresh failed. Previous facts remain visible; retry.

content.zh-CN: 按发布时冻结的租户时区和政策每天扫描，首次不早于发布满 24 小时，最多三个有效批次。截止相等停止自动催办；恢复不补发错过周期。原操作者失权时计划阻断，管理员可在自身权限内手动催办，但不会接管自动主体。
content.en-US: The plan uses the frozen publication timezone and policy, starting no earlier than 24 hours after publication and allowing at most three positive batches. Automatic reminders stop at the deadline; resumption does not catch up missed cycles. Revoked original authority blocks the plan. Administrators may send authorized manual reminders but cannot take over the automatic actor.

content.zh-CN: 仅恢复原操作者的现有计划，不回补已错过的日期；截止或失效后不能恢复。
content.en-US: Resume under the original actor without catching up missed dates. A deadline or expired version prevents resumption.

ACTOR_OR_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 请核实原操作者权限、租户成员状态和公告有效性；恢复后由原操作者显式恢复计划。
ACTOR_OR_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: Check the original actor permissions, membership and announcement validity, then explicitly resume as the original actor.

EXECUTION_FAILURE.zh-CN: 执行失败，请联系管理员排查后，由原操作者恢复计划。
EXECUTION_FAILURE.en-US: Execution failed. Ask an administrator to investigate before the original actor resumes the plan.

description.zh-CN: 请刷新同一预览或批次；不会重新发送。
description.en-US: Refresh the same preview or batch. This does not resend notifications.

title.zh-CN: 刷新失败，仍显示上次事实，请重试。
title.en-US: Refresh failed. Previous facts remain visible; retry.

description.zh-CN: 自动扫描或手动受理后在此核对，翻页和查看不会重新发送。
description.en-US: Accepted manual batches and automatic scans appear here. Paging and viewing never resend reminders.

title.zh-CN: 批次历史刷新失败，仍显示上次结果，请重试。
title.en-US: History refresh failed. Previous results remain visible; retry.
